tasks.title: Use drawings and specifications for today's work
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the drawing/specification, identify the key dimensions or requirements and explain how they control the task.

tasks.title: Use digital design information
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the digital drawing/model/information and explain what you took from it.

tasks.title: Follow the induction, RAMS and toolbox information
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show or explain the safe system you are following and the key control that applies to today's task.

tasks.title: Identify hazards and changed conditions
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the work area, identify the main hazards and explain what would make you stop or change the work.

tasks.title: Select and use PPE and RPE
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the PPE/RPE used and explain the hazard each item controls.

tasks.title: Use dust extraction, LEV and task controls
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the control in use and explain why it is suitable.

tasks.title: Estimate materials and produce a cutting list
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the dimensions/calculation and cutting list, including how you allowed for fixings and efficient cutting.

tasks.title: Select timber and associated products
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the timber/products selected, explain suitability and identify any defect or moisture/decay issue checked.

tasks.title: Keep the work area safe and tidy
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the safe working area, access/egress and how trip or handling risks are controlled.

tasks.title: Reduce waste and use resources sustainably
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show reuse/recycling/disposal arrangements and explain how timber/resources are used efficiently and sustainably.
